wire.sessions_remote_stop.approval_stop_.role: approval prompt shown before the sessions tool asks another device to stop one of its sessions idle-only
wire.sessions_remote_stop.approval_stop_.note: {address} is the session id or name and {peer} the device name (keep both verbatim). The promise is: the OTHER device decides, only an idle session ends, no signal is ever sent, a working session is refused. Keep the 'refused while it is working' tail.

wire.sessions_remote_stop.force_refused.role: tool-result receipt when the agent asked to force-stop a session on another device
wire.sessions_remote_stop.force_refused.note: No placeholders. Force (the signalling escalation) is never sent across devices, so nothing was sent at all. The remedy is the operator acting on that device; do not name a command.

wire.sessions_remote_stop.not_running.role: tool-result receipt when the other device reports the session is not running
wire.sessions_remote_stop.not_running.note: {name} is the session name or id, {peer} the device name (keep verbatim). Not an error: there was nothing to end.

wire.sessions_remote_stop.relay_restart.role: tool-result receipt when this device's own mesh relay is an older build than the tool
wire.sessions_remote_stop.relay_restart.note: No placeholders. `lop network restart` is a command: keep it verbatim in backticks. Nothing was sent to the other device.

wire.sessions_remote_stop.unconfirmed.role: tool-result receipt when the stop request was sent but no answer came back
wire.sessions_remote_stop.unconfirmed.note: {peer} is the device name (keep verbatim, both times). The stop MAY have happened — do not say it failed or succeeded. `sessions op=list peer={peer}` is a tool call spelling: keep it verbatim in backticks. Nothing was retried automatically.

wire.sessions_remote_stop.unsupported.role: tool-result receipt when the other device's build does not offer the idle-only stop
wire.sessions_remote_stop.unsupported.note: {peer} is the device name (keep verbatim). Nothing was sent, so nothing can have stopped. Two remedies: update that device, or have the operator stop it there.
